title: IREN Stock Falls Even as JPMorgan Goes Bullish
summary: Shares in AI data center operator IREN Limited (IREN) fell about 4% to around $21 on Tuesday morning. This came even after four-star JPMorgan analyst Richard Choe assigned the stock a Buy rating. Choe is bullish on IREN’s fiscal Q1 2027 earnings, which showed AI cloud revenue surged 182% quarter-over-quarter to $200 million.
